profile.name: Kamal Raj Sekar
profile.tagline: 2x Failed AI SaaS Maker | Published Author | Tech Agile Coach | AI Enthusiast | Speaker | Open Source Contributor

summary:
I help organizations become technically agile and leverage AI throughout their engineering processes wherever applicable. Through Ampyard, we provide custom AI workshops tailored to your business context and tech stack.

With 15+ years experience, I've co-created AI products (FaceQuest and Notesally), authored books on TDD and AI-augmented development, and written the white paper 'Real Productivity, Rare Pushbacks' on AI agents. I work with teams from startups to Fortune 500s, helping them ship quality software using proven engineering practices and modern AI tools.

experience.role: Tech Agile Coach & AI Consultant | Cofounder & Director
experience.details:
★ Provide Tech Agility Coaching and AI Consulting to startups and Fortune 500 companies, helping teams adopt modern engineering practices and AI-augmented workflows.

★ Deliver custom AI workshops tailored to clients' business context, use cases, and tech stacks.

★ Authored the whitepaper 'Real Productivity, Rare Pushbacks' on integrating AI agents into product development.

★ Built MVPs for two AI SaaS products:
- **FaceQuest** – AI-powered facial recognition platform (1:1 verification & 1:N search)
- **Notesally** – AI assistant for sales productivity and CRM data quality
